entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: The guildhall of the Cult of Rakdos on Ravnica, deep in the Undercity around an active volcano and Rakdos's lava pit.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose guildhall is Rix Maadi.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon leader of the Cult of Rakdos who slumbers in the lava pit.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Rix Maadi stands.

entities.name: Demon's Vestibule
entities.description: The ancient wurm-carved tunnel and stone staircase leading to Rix Maadi.

entities.name: Jester's Crypt
entities.description: A dark, shadow-shrouded tunnel in Rix Maadi where Rakdos takes displeasing cultists and where blood witches are created.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A maze race whose route passed through Rix Maadi.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war on Ravnica during which heroes sought Rakdos's aid.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A razor witch resurrected as a blood witch in the Jester's Crypt.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: Brings Hekara's corpse to the Jester's Crypt.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A planeswalker who visits Rix Maadi during and after the war, searching for Rat.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: A Selesnya guild leader who fought in the melee.

entities.name: Exava
entities.description: A maze runner wounded in the battle at Rix Maadi.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: A maze runner wounded in the battle at Rix Maadi.

events.summary: During the Implicit Maze, a battle erupts in Rix Maadi between Rakdos and Selesnya, wounding Exava and Emmara.
events.quote: a battle broke out between the local Rakdos and Selesnya representatives

events.summary: Heroes seek Rakdos's aid during the War of the Spark but Rakdos refuses.
events.quote: Although Rakdos himself refused to aid

events.summary: Tomik Vrona delivers Hekara's corpse to the Jester's Crypt where she is resurrected as a blood witch.
events.quote: where she was resurrected into a blood witch

events.summary: After the war Teyo returns alone looking for Rat, fights Whipsaw and speaks with Hekara, leaving empty-handed.
events.quote: After the war, Teyo returned alone, looking for Rat.
